```{r}
############################################################
## PURPOSE
##   Differential expression across three RNA expression clusters
##   (global LRT + pairwise Wald tests).
##
## INPUT
##   - VST_data_GENCODEv47/htseq_raw_counts_with_gene_names.csv (raw counts)
##   - VST_data_GENCODEv47/gene_annotation_from_GTF.tsv
##
## DESIGN
##   ~ Cluster; prefilter count >= 10 in >= 3 samples
##   Significance: padj < 0.05 and |shrunken log2FC| >= 1
##   Positive log2FC = higher in the first cluster named
##   Shrinkage lfc pulls noisy gene's log2FC toward 0,
##
## KNOWN LIMITATIONS
##   - Clusters were derived from the same expression data
##   - Purity / batch not yet modelled
############################################################

set.seed(42)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(DESeq2)
  library(data.table)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(pheatmap)
  library(RColorBrewer)
})

# ----------------------------
# Paths (fixed names, no date/time stamps)
# ----------------------------
input_dir  <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/RNASeq/4_Count_file_pILC/VST_data_GENCODEv47"
count_file <- file.path(input_dir, "htseq_raw_counts_with_gene_names.csv")
annot_file <- file.path(input_dir, "gene_annotation_from_GTF.tsv")

out_root     <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/RNASeq/DESeq2/DESeq2_3clusters"
out_dir_name <- "pILC_DESeq2_3clusters"
out_dir      <- file.path(out_root, out_dir_name)
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

if (!file.exists(count_file)) stop("Count file not found: ", count_file)
if (!file.exists(annot_file)) stop("Annotation file not found: ", annot_file)

# ----------------------------
# Cluster assignments
# ----------------------------
cluster_map <- c(
  "TP13.1150" = "Cluster 1",
  "TP07.626"  = "Cluster 1",
  "TP17.M11"  = "Cluster 1",
  "TP03.117"  = "Cluster 1",
  "TP05.668"  = "Cluster 1",
  "TP05.1063" = "Cluster 1",
  "TP08.1319" = "Cluster 1",
  "TP13.820"  = "Cluster 1",
  "TP09.746"  = "Cluster 1",
  "TP11.1516" = "Cluster 1",

  "TP08.2202" = "Cluster 2",
  "TP04.104"  = "Cluster 2",
  "TP05.791"  = "Cluster 2",
  "TP11.372"  = "Cluster 2",
  "TP15.M509" = "Cluster 2",
  "TP14.490"  = "Cluster 2",
  "TP05.232"  = "Cluster 2",
  "TP08.356"  = "Cluster 2",
  "TP09.9"    = "Cluster 2",
  "TP12.2045" = "Cluster 2",

  "TP12.1864" = "Cluster 3",
  "TP11.1780" = "Cluster 3",
  "TP08.370"  = "Cluster 3",
  "TP08.517"  = "Cluster 3",
  "TP10.705"  = "Cluster 3",
  "TP05.726"  = "Cluster 3",
  "TP07.197"  = "Cluster 3",
  "TP13.862"  = "Cluster 3",
  "TP14.586"  = "Cluster 3",
  "TP11.1127" = "Cluster 3",
  "TP12.880"  = "Cluster 3"
)

cluster_colors <- c(
  "Cluster 1" = "#1B9E77",
  "Cluster 2" = "#D95F02",
  "Cluster 3" = "#7570B3"
)

# ----------------------------
# Read and validate counts
# ----------------------------
count_dt <- fread(count_file, data.table = TRUE)

if (!("Gene" %in% names(count_dt))) stop("Input must contain a column named 'Gene'.")
if (anyDuplicated(count_dt$Gene)) stop("Duplicate gene names detected. Resolve before DESeq2.")
if (anyNA(count_dt$Gene) || any(count_dt$Gene == "")) stop("Missing gene names detected.")

sample_cols     <- setdiff(names(count_dt), "Gene")
missing_samples <- setdiff(names(cluster_map), sample_cols)
extra_samples   <- setdiff(sample_cols, names(cluster_map))

if (length(missing_samples)) {
  stop("Cluster samples missing from count matrix: ", paste(missing_samples, collapse = ", "))
}
if (length(extra_samples)) {
  stop("Count samples without cluster assignment: ", paste(extra_samples, collapse = ", "))
}

# Match count columns exactly to the declared metadata order
count_dt <- count_dt[, c("Gene", names(cluster_map)), with = FALSE]
count_matrix <- as.matrix(count_dt[, -"Gene"])
rownames(count_matrix) <- count_dt$Gene
storage.mode(count_matrix) <- "numeric"

if (anyNA(count_matrix)) stop("Missing count values detected.")
if (any(count_matrix < 0)) stop("Negative count values detected.")
if (any(count_matrix != round(count_matrix))) stop("Non-integer count values detected.")
storage.mode(count_matrix) <- "integer"

# Remove HTSeq summary rows if present
summary_rows <- grepl("^__", rownames(count_matrix))
if (any(summary_rows)) count_matrix <- count_matrix[!summary_rows, , drop = FALSE]

# ----------------------------
# Gene annotation (symbol, biotype) from the GTF
# ----------------------------
gene_annot <- fread(annot_file)
gene_annot <- gene_annot[, .(Gene, ensembl_id, gene_symbol, gene_biotype)]
if (anyDuplicated(gene_annot$Gene)) stop("Duplicate Gene labels in annotation file.")

add_annotation <- function(dt) {
  merge(dt, gene_annot, by = "Gene", all.x = TRUE, sort = FALSE)
}

# ----------------------------
# Sample metadata
# ----------------------------
metadata <- data.frame(
  Sample = names(cluster_map),
  Cluster = factor(
    unname(cluster_map),
    levels = c("Cluster 1", "Cluster 2", "Cluster 3")
  ),
  row.names = names(cluster_map),
  check.names = FALSE
)

fwrite(
  as.data.table(metadata, keep.rownames = FALSE),
  file.path(out_dir, "pILC_cluster_metadata.tsv"),
  sep = "\t"
)

# ----------------------------
# DESeq2 object and prefiltering
# ----------------------------
dds0 <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = count_matrix,
  colData   = metadata,
  design    = ~ Cluster
)

# Retain genes with >= 10 reads in at least 3 tumors
keep <- rowSums(counts(dds0) >= 10) >= 3
filter_audit <- data.table(
  Gene = rownames(dds0),
  Total_count = rowSums(counts(dds0)),
  Samples_with_count_ge_10 = rowSums(counts(dds0) >= 10),
  Retained_for_DESeq2 = keep
)
fwrite(
  add_annotation(filter_audit),
  file.path(out_dir, "pILC_DESeq2_gene_filter_audit.tsv"),
  sep = "\t"
)

dds <- dds0[keep, ]
message("Genes before filtering: ", nrow(dds0))
message("Genes retained: ", nrow(dds))

# ----------------------------
# Global likelihood-ratio test
# ----------------------------
dds_lrt <- DESeq(
  dds,
  test = "LRT",
  reduced = ~ 1,
  parallel = FALSE,
  quiet = FALSE
)

lrt <- as.data.table(as.data.frame(results(dds_lrt)), keep.rownames = "Gene")
# The log2FoldChange / lfcSE columns of an LRT show only one coefficient
# (last cluster vs reference), so they are removed to avoid misreading.
lrt[, c("log2FoldChange", "lfcSE") := NULL]
setorder(lrt, padj, pvalue, -baseMean, na.last = TRUE)
lrt[, Significant_FDR05 := !is.na(padj) & padj < 0.05]
lrt <- add_annotation(lrt)
setorder(lrt, padj, pvalue, -baseMean, na.last = TRUE)

fwrite(
  lrt,
  file.path(out_dir, "pILC_DESeq2_global_LRT_any_cluster.tsv"),
  sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, na = ""
)

# ----------------------------
# Pairwise Wald tests
# ----------------------------
dds_wald <- DESeq(
  dds,
  test = "Wald",
  parallel = FALSE,
  quiet = FALSE
)

comparisons <- list(
  Cluster1_vs_Cluster2 = c("Cluster", "Cluster 1", "Cluster 2"),
  Cluster1_vs_Cluster3 = c("Cluster", "Cluster 1", "Cluster 3"),
  Cluster2_vs_Cluster3 = c("Cluster", "Cluster 2", "Cluster 3")
)

result_list <- list()

for (comparison_name in names(comparisons)) {
  contrast_vector <- comparisons[[comparison_name]]

  raw_result <- results(
    dds_wald,
    contrast = contrast_vector,
    alpha = 0.05,
    independentFiltering = TRUE
  )

  # Built-in normal shrinkage; if it fails, unshrunken values are used
  # and the LFC_type column records which one was used.
  lfc_type <- "shrunken_normal"
  shrunk_result <- tryCatch(
    lfcShrink(
      dds_wald,
      contrast = contrast_vector,
      res = raw_result,
      type = "normal"
    ),
    error = function(e) {
      warning("LFC shrinkage failed for ", comparison_name, ": ", conditionMessage(e))
      lfc_type <<- "unshrunken"
      raw_result
    }
  )

  result_dt <- as.data.table(as.data.frame(shrunk_result), keep.rownames = "Gene")
  result_dt[, Comparison := comparison_name]
  result_dt[, LFC_type := lfc_type]
  result_dt[, Significant_FDR05 := !is.na(padj) & padj < 0.05]
  result_dt[, Significant_FDR05_LFC1 :=
    !is.na(padj) & padj < 0.05 & abs(log2FoldChange) >= 1]
  result_dt[, Direction := fifelse(
    Significant_FDR05_LFC1 & log2FoldChange > 0,
    paste0("Higher_in_", contrast_vector[2]),
    fifelse(
      Significant_FDR05_LFC1 & log2FoldChange < 0,
      paste0("Higher_in_", contrast_vector[3]),
      "Not_significant"
    )
  )]
  result_dt <- add_annotation(result_dt)
  result_dt[, Abs_log2FC_for_sorting := abs(log2FoldChange)]

  setorder(
    result_dt,
    padj,
    pvalue,
    -Abs_log2FC_for_sorting,
    na.last = TRUE
  )

  result_dt[, Abs_log2FC_for_sorting := NULL]

  result_list[[comparison_name]] <- result_dt

  fwrite(
    result_dt,
    file.path(out_dir, paste0("pILC_DESeq2_", comparison_name, ".tsv")),
    sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, na = ""
  )
}

all_pairwise <- rbindlist(result_list, use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE)
fwrite(
  all_pairwise,
  file.path(out_dir, "pILC_DESeq2_all_pairwise_results.tsv"),
  sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, na = ""
)

# ----------------------------
# Normalized counts and VST
# ----------------------------
normalized_counts <- counts(dds_wald, normalized = TRUE)
normalized_dt <- as.data.table(normalized_counts, keep.rownames = "Gene")
fwrite(
  add_annotation(normalized_dt),
  file.path(out_dir, "pILC_DESeq2_normalized_counts.tsv"),
  sep = "\t", quote = FALSE
)

cluster_means <- data.table(Gene = rownames(normalized_counts))
for (cluster_name in levels(metadata$Cluster)) {
  samples <- rownames(metadata)[metadata$Cluster == cluster_name]
  safe_name <- gsub(" ", "_", cluster_name)
  cluster_means[, (paste0(safe_name, "_mean_normalized_count")) :=
    rowMeans(normalized_counts[, samples, drop = FALSE])]
}
fwrite(
  add_annotation(cluster_means),
  file.path(out_dir, "pILC_DESeq2_cluster_mean_normalized_counts.tsv"),
  sep = "\t", quote = FALSE
)

# blind = FALSE uses the cluster design: good for display, but it makes
# clusters look more separated than the raw data. Do not use it for QC claims.
vst_object <- vst(dds_wald, blind = FALSE)
vst_matrix <- assay(vst_object)
fwrite(
  as.data.table(vst_matrix, keep.rownames = "Gene"),
  file.path(out_dir, "pILC_DESeq2_VST_from_raw_counts.tsv"),
  sep = "\t", quote = FALSE
)

# ----------------------------
# PCA
# ----------------------------
pca_data <- plotPCA(vst_object, intgroup = "Cluster", returnData = TRUE)
percent_var <- round(100 * attr(pca_data, "percentVar"), 1)

pca_plot <- ggplot(pca_data, aes(PC1, PC2, color = Cluster, label = name)) +
  geom_point(size = 4) +
  geom_text(size = 2.7, vjust = -0.8, show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = cluster_colors, drop = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "pILC RNA-seq PCA by expression cluster",
    subtitle = "DESeq2 VST generated from raw HTSeq counts",
    x = paste0("PC1: ", percent_var[1], "% variance"),
    y = paste0("PC2: ", percent_var[2], "% variance")
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.title = element_blank()
  )

ggsave(
  file.path(out_dir, "pILC_DESeq2_PCA_clusters.png"),
  pca_plot, width = 9, height = 7, dpi = 300
)
ggsave(
  file.path(out_dir, "pILC_DESeq2_PCA_clusters.pdf"),
  pca_plot, width = 9, height = 7
)

# ----------------------------
# Volcano plots
# ----------------------------
for (comparison_name in names(result_list)) {
  x <- copy(result_list[[comparison_name]])
  x[, minus_log10_padj := -log10(pmax(padj, .Machine$double.xmin))]
  x[is.na(minus_log10_padj), minus_log10_padj := 0]

  contrast_vector <- comparisons[[comparison_name]]
  up_label   <- paste0("Higher in ", contrast_vector[2])
  down_label <- paste0("Higher in ", contrast_vector[3])
  x[, Plot_group := "Not significant"]
  x[Significant_FDR05_LFC1 & log2FoldChange > 0, Plot_group := up_label]
  x[Significant_FDR05_LFC1 & log2FoldChange < 0, Plot_group := down_label]

  plot_colors <- c(
    "Not significant" = "#BDBDBD",
    setNames(cluster_colors[contrast_vector[2]], up_label),
    setNames(cluster_colors[contrast_vector[3]], down_label)
  )

  volcano <- ggplot(x, aes(log2FoldChange, minus_log10_padj, color = Plot_group)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.65, size = 1.3) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(-1, 1), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey35") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey35") +
    scale_color_manual(values = plot_colors, drop = FALSE) +
    labs(
      title = gsub("_", " ", comparison_name),
      subtitle = "DESeq2; FDR <0.05 and |shrunken log2FC| >=1",
      x = paste0("Log2 fold change: ", contrast_vector[2], " / ", contrast_vector[3]),
      y = "-log10 adjusted P-value",
      color = NULL
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )

  ggsave(
    file.path(out_dir, paste0("pILC_DESeq2_volcano_", comparison_name, ".png")),
    volcano, width = 8.5, height = 7, dpi = 300
  )
  ggsave(
    file.path(out_dir, paste0("pILC_DESeq2_volcano_", comparison_name, ".pdf")),
    volcano, width = 8.5, height = 7
  )
}

# ----------------------------
# Global LRT heatmap: top 100 genes by adjusted P-value
# ----------------------------
top_lrt_genes <- head(lrt[!is.na(padj), Gene], 100)
if (length(top_lrt_genes) >= 2) {
  heatmap_matrix <- vst_matrix[top_lrt_genes, , drop = FALSE]
  heatmap_matrix <- t(scale(t(heatmap_matrix)))
  heatmap_matrix[heatmap_matrix > 2.5]  <- 2.5
  heatmap_matrix[heatmap_matrix < -2.5] <- -2.5

  annotation_col <- data.frame(Cluster = metadata$Cluster)
  rownames(annotation_col) <- rownames(metadata)
  annotation_colors <- list(Cluster = cluster_colors)

  draw_heatmap <- function() {
    pheatmap(
      heatmap_matrix,
      color = colorRampPalette(c("#2166AC", "white", "#B2182B"))(101),
      annotation_col = annotation_col,
      annotation_colors = annotation_colors,
      cluster_rows = TRUE,
      cluster_cols = TRUE,
      show_colnames = TRUE,
      show_rownames = TRUE,
      fontsize_row = 5,
      fontsize_col = 7,
      border_color = NA,
      main = "Top 100 genes differing across the three RNA clusters"
    )
  }

  png(
    file.path(out_dir, "pILC_DESeq2_global_LRT_top100_heatmap.png"),
    width = 3000, height = 3600, res = 300
  )
  draw_heatmap()
  dev.off()

  pdf(
    file.path(out_dir, "pILC_DESeq2_global_LRT_top100_heatmap.pdf"),
    width = 12, height = 14
  )
  draw_heatmap()
  dev.off()
}

# ----------------------------
# Summary table
# ----------------------------
summary_dt <- rbindlist(lapply(names(result_list), function(comparison_name) {
  x <- result_list[[comparison_name]]
  contrast_vector <- comparisons[[comparison_name]]
  data.table(
    Analysis = comparison_name,
    Cluster_A = contrast_vector[2],
    Cluster_B = contrast_vector[3],
    Tested_genes = nrow(x),
    FDR05_genes = sum(x$Significant_FDR05, na.rm = TRUE),
    FDR05_LFC1_genes = sum(x$Significant_FDR05_LFC1, na.rm = TRUE),
    Higher_in_Cluster_A = sum(
      x$Significant_FDR05_LFC1 & x$log2FoldChange > 0,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    Higher_in_Cluster_B = sum(
      x$Significant_FDR05_LFC1 & x$log2FoldChange < 0,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  )
}))

global_row <- data.table(
  Analysis = "Global_LRT_any_cluster",
  Cluster_A = "All",
  Cluster_B = "All",
  Tested_genes = nrow(lrt),
  FDR05_genes = sum(lrt$Significant_FDR05, na.rm = TRUE),
  FDR05_LFC1_genes = NA_integer_,
  Higher_in_Cluster_A = NA_integer_,
  Higher_in_Cluster_B = NA_integer_
)

summary_dt <- rbind(global_row, summary_dt, fill = TRUE)
fwrite(
  summary_dt,
  file.path(out_dir, "pILC_DESeq2_analysis_summary.tsv"),
  sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, na = ""
)

writeLines(
  c(
    "pILC three-cluster DESeq2 analysis",
    "Seed: 42",
    "Input: raw HTSeq integer counts (GENCODE v47 gene labels)",
    "Design: ~ Cluster",
    "Prefilter: count >=10 in at least 3 samples",
    "Global test: likelihood-ratio test, reduced model ~1",
    "Pairwise tests: Wald tests with normal LFC shrinkage (see LFC_type column)",
    "Primary significance definition: adjusted P <0.05 and |shrunken log2FC| >=1",
    "Important: clusters were derived from these expression data. Results describe cluster-characterizing genes and are not independent validation."
  ),
  file.path(out_dir, "README_pILC_DESeq2.txt")
)

writeLines(
  capture.output(sessionInfo()),
  file.path(out_dir, "sessionInfo.txt")
)

# ----------------------------
# One archive for upload/review (working directory is restored afterwards)
# ----------------------------
make_archive <- function(root, folder_name, archive_path) {
  old_wd <- setwd(root)
  on.exit(setwd(old_wd), add = TRUE)
  utils::tar(archive_path, files = folder_name, compression = "gzip", tar = "internal")
}

archive_file <- file.path(out_root, "pILC_DESeq2_3clusters.tar.gz")
make_archive(out_root, out_dir_name, archive_file)

message("DESeq2 analysis completed.")
message("Output directory: ", out_dir)
message("Archive to upload: ", archive_file)
print(summary_dt)
```
```{r}
# ============================================================
# Named-gene-only outputs (bare ENSG IDs removed AFTER testing)
# DESeq2 ran on all genes that passed the prefilter, named and unnamed together. Every gene got its log2FC, p-value and padj.
# only afterwards, the rows whose label is a bare ENSG ID were dropped to make the named_genes tables and plots.
# The full results above are unchanged; padj values are kept as they are.
# ============================================================

# A label is "unnamed" only if it is a bare ENSG ID (no symbol, no "SYMBOL|ENSG")
is_unnamed <- function(gene) grepl("^ENSG[0-9]+(\\.[0-9]+)?$", gene)

named_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "named_genes_only")
dir.create(named_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# --- How many genes are unnamed, and what are they? ---
unnamed_audit <- lrt[, .(
  Genes_tested = .N,
  Unnamed_genes = sum(is_unnamed(Gene)),
  Unnamed_among_FDR05 = sum(is_unnamed(Gene) & Significant_FDR05, na.rm = TRUE),
  Named_among_FDR05 = sum(!is_unnamed(Gene) & Significant_FDR05, na.rm = TRUE)
)]
fwrite(unnamed_audit, file.path(named_dir, "pILC_DESeq2_unnamed_gene_audit.tsv"), sep = "\t")

# Biotype of the unnamed genes (expected: mostly lncRNA)
unnamed_biotype <- lrt[is_unnamed(Gene), .N, by = gene_biotype][order(-N)]
fwrite(unnamed_biotype, file.path(named_dir, "pILC_DESeq2_unnamed_gene_biotypes.tsv"), sep = "\t")
print(unnamed_audit)
print(unnamed_biotype)

# --- Tables ---
lrt_named <- lrt[!is_unnamed(Gene)]
fwrite(lrt_named,
       file.path(named_dir, "pILC_DESeq2_global_LRT_any_cluster_named_genes.tsv"),
       sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, na = "")

result_named_list <- lapply(result_list, function(x) x[!is_unnamed(Gene)])
for (comparison_name in names(result_named_list)) {
  fwrite(result_named_list[[comparison_name]],
         file.path(named_dir, paste0("pILC_DESeq2_", comparison_name, "_named_genes.tsv")),
         sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, na = "")
}
fwrite(rbindlist(result_named_list, use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE),
       file.path(named_dir, "pILC_DESeq2_all_pairwise_results_named_genes.tsv"),
       sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, na = "")

# --- Heatmap: top 100 NAMED genes by LRT adjusted P-value ---
top_named_genes <- head(lrt_named[!is.na(padj), Gene], 100)

if (length(top_named_genes) >= 2) {
  hm_named <- vst_matrix[top_named_genes, , drop = FALSE]
  hm_named <- t(scale(t(hm_named)))
  hm_named[hm_named > 2.5]  <- 2.5
  hm_named[hm_named < -2.5] <- -2.5

  annotation_col_named <- data.frame(Cluster = metadata$Cluster)
  rownames(annotation_col_named) <- rownames(metadata)

  draw_named_heatmap <- function() {
    pheatmap(
      hm_named,
      color = colorRampPalette(c("#2166AC", "white", "#B2182B"))(101),
      annotation_col = annotation_col_named,
      annotation_colors = list(Cluster = cluster_colors),
      cluster_rows = TRUE,
      cluster_cols = TRUE,
      show_colnames = TRUE,
      show_rownames = TRUE,
      fontsize_row = 5,
      fontsize_col = 7,
      border_color = NA,
      main = "Top 100 named genes differing across the three RNA clusters"
    )
  }

  png(file.path(named_dir, "pILC_DESeq2_global_LRT_top100_named_genes_heatmap.png"),
      width = 3000, height = 3600, res = 300)
  draw_named_heatmap()
  dev.off()

  pdf(file.path(named_dir, "pILC_DESeq2_global_LRT_top100_named_genes_heatmap.pdf"),
      width = 12, height = 14)
  draw_named_heatmap()
  dev.off()
}

# --- Volcano plots without unnamed genes ---
for (comparison_name in names(result_named_list)) {
  x <- copy(result_named_list[[comparison_name]])
  x[, minus_log10_padj := -log10(pmax(padj, .Machine$double.xmin))]
  x[is.na(minus_log10_padj), minus_log10_padj := 0]

  contrast_vector <- comparisons[[comparison_name]]
  up_label   <- paste0("Higher in ", contrast_vector[2])
  down_label <- paste0("Higher in ", contrast_vector[3])
  x[, Plot_group := "Not significant"]
  x[Significant_FDR05_LFC1 & log2FoldChange > 0, Plot_group := up_label]
  x[Significant_FDR05_LFC1 & log2FoldChange < 0, Plot_group := down_label]

  plot_colors <- c(
    "Not significant" = "#BDBDBD",
    setNames(cluster_colors[contrast_vector[2]], up_label),
    setNames(cluster_colors[contrast_vector[3]], down_label)
  )

  volcano_named <- ggplot(x, aes(log2FoldChange, minus_log10_padj, color = Plot_group)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.65, size = 1.3) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(-1, 1), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey35") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey35") +
    scale_color_manual(values = plot_colors, drop = FALSE) +
    labs(
      title = paste(gsub("_", " ", comparison_name), "(named genes only)"),
      subtitle = "DESeq2; FDR <0.05 and |shrunken log2FC| >=1; bare ENSG IDs excluded after testing",
      x = paste0("Log2 fold change: ", contrast_vector[2], " / ", contrast_vector[3]),
      y = "-log10 adjusted P-value",
      color = NULL
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          legend.position = "bottom")

  ggsave(file.path(named_dir, paste0("pILC_DESeq2_volcano_", comparison_name, "_named_genes.png")),
         volcano_named, width = 8.5, height = 7, dpi = 300)
  ggsave(file.path(named_dir, paste0("pILC_DESeq2_volcano_", comparison_name, "_named_genes.pdf")),
         volcano_named, width = 8.5, height = 7)
}
```

```{r}
set.seed(42)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(data.table)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggrepel)
})

# ----------------------------
# Paths (fixed names, no dates)
# ----------------------------
named_dir <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/RNASeq/DESeq2/DESeq2_3clusters/pILC_DESeq2_3clusters/named_genes_only"
res_file  <- file.path(named_dir, "pILC_DESeq2_all_pairwise_results_named_genes.tsv")
if (!file.exists(res_file)) stop("Missing: ", res_file)

# ----------------------------
# Settings
# ----------------------------
n_label <- 8                          # genes labelled per side
protein_coding_labels_only <- FALSE   # TRUE = label protein-coding genes only
cluster_colors <- c("Cluster 1" = "#1B9E77", "Cluster 2" = "#D95F02", "Cluster 3" = "#7570B3")

x <- fread(res_file)
x <- x[!is.na(padj)]
x[, minus_log10_padj := -log10(pmax(padj, .Machine$double.xmin))]

comparisons <- unique(x$Comparison)   # e.g. Cluster1_vs_Cluster2 (positive log2FC = higher in the first)

for (cmp in comparisons) {
  d <- copy(x[Comparison == cmp])
  cl <- strsplit(cmp, "_vs_")[[1]]
  cl <- sub("Cluster", "Cluster ", cl)             # "Cluster 1", "Cluster 2"
  up_lab   <- paste0("Higher in ", cl[1])
  down_lab <- paste0("Higher in ", cl[2])

  d[, Group := "Not significant"]
  d[Significant_FDR05_LFC1 == TRUE & log2FoldChange > 0, Group := up_lab]
  d[Significant_FDR05_LFC1 == TRUE & log2FoldChange < 0, Group := down_lab]

  # Genes to label: most significant per side
  cand <- d[Group != "Not significant"]
  if (protein_coding_labels_only) cand <- cand[gene_biotype == "protein_coding"]
  lab <- rbind(
    cand[log2FoldChange > 0][order(padj)][seq_len(min(n_label, .N))],
    cand[log2FoldChange < 0][order(padj)][seq_len(min(n_label, .N))]
  )

  cols <- c("Not significant" = "#BDBDBD",
            setNames(cluster_colors[cl[1]], up_lab),
            setNames(cluster_colors[cl[2]], down_lab))

  n_sig <- sum(d$Group != "Not significant")

  p <- ggplot(d, aes(log2FoldChange, minus_log10_padj, color = Group)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 1.2) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(-1, 1), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey35") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey35") +
    geom_text_repel(data = lab, aes(label = gene_symbol), color = "black",
                    size = 3, max.overlaps = Inf, box.padding = 0.35,
                    segment.color = "grey50", segment.size = 0.3, min.segment.length = 0) +
    scale_color_manual(values = cols, breaks = c(up_lab, down_lab, "Not significant")) +
    labs(title = paste0(cl[1], " vs ", cl[2], " (named genes only)"),
         subtitle = paste0(nrow(d), " named genes tested; ", n_sig,
                           " with FDR < 0.05 and |shrunken log2FC| >= 1; top ", n_label,
                           " per side labelled"),
         x = paste0("Log2 fold change (", cl[1], " / ", cl[2], ")"),
         y = "-log10 adjusted P-value", color = NULL) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    theme(plot.title.position = "plot",
          plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), legend.position = "bottom")

  stem <- file.path(named_dir, paste0("pILC_DESeq2_volcano_", cmp, "_named_genes_labelled"))
  ggsave(paste0(stem, ".png"), p, width = 9, height = 7.5, dpi = 300)
  ggsave(paste0(stem, ".pdf"), p, width = 9, height = 7.5)

  fwrite(lab[, .(Comparison, gene_symbol, gene_biotype, log2FoldChange, padj, Group)],
         file.path(named_dir, paste0("pILC_DESeq2_volcano_", cmp, "_labelled_genes.tsv")), sep = "\t")
}
message("Done: labelled volcano plots written to ", named_dir)
```
